description: FANUC LR-10iA/10 (LR Mate 200iD/7L geometry, kinematic: it follows the plan inside the datasheet limits) picks a carton with a five-zone suction gripper (pneumatic cylinders, bellows cups, one ejector per zone) and places it turned. The checks pin the planner kinematics to the URDF, the cycle times, the vacuum and the static cup forces to hand calculations, and the holding outcome of every model to the reduced model of the optimiser.
